mapper.update: SET LOCAL lock_timeout='4s'; SET LOCAL statement_timeout='5s'
mapper.select: SELECT script_sha256 FROM ad_event_sync_schema WHERE version=1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ad_event_sync_checkpoint(singleton,source_id,source_fingerprint) VALUES(true,#{source},#{fingerprint}) ON CONFLICT(singleton) DO NOTHING
mapper.update: UPDATE ad_event_sync_checkpoint SET state='PAUSED',error_code='EXHAUSTED',updated_at=clock_timestamp() WHERE state='RUNNING' AND lease_until<=clock_timestamp() AND attempts>=3

UPDATE ad_event_sync_checkpoint SET state='RUNNING',worker=#{worker},fence=fence+1,lease_until=clock_timestamp()+interval '30 seconds', epoch=CASE WHEN state='COMPLETE' THEN epoch+1 ELSE epoch END, upper_id=CASE WHEN state='COMPLETE' THEN NULL ELSE upper_id END, cursor_id=CASE WHEN state='COMPLETE' THEN 0 ELSE cursor_id END, scanned=CASE WHEN state='COMPLETE' THEN 0 ELSE scanned END,copied=CASE WHEN state='COMPLETE' THEN 0 ELSE copied END, updated_at=clock_timestamp() WHERE state IN ('READY','COMPLETE','RUNNING') AND attempts<3 AND available_at<=clock_timestamp() AND (lease_until IS NULL OR lease_until<=clock_timestamp())

UPDATE ad_event_sync_checkpoint SET attempts=attempts+1,lease_until=clock_timestamp()+interval '30 seconds',updated_at=clock_timestamp() WHERE worker=#{worker} AND fence=#{fence} AND state='RUNNING' AND lease_until>clock_timestamp() AND attempts<3
mapper.select: SELECT count(*) FROM ad_event_sync_checkpoint WHERE worker=#{worker} AND fence=#{fence} AND state='RUNNING' AND lease_until>clock_timestamp()
mapper.update: UPDATE ad_event_sync_checkpoint SET upper_id=#{upper} WHERE singleton=true AND upper_id IS NULL AND state='RUNNING'

UPDATE ad_event_sync_checkpoint SET cursor_id=#{cursor},scanned=scanned+#{scanned},copied=copied+#{copied},attempts=0, state=CASE WHEN #{complete} THEN 'COMPLETE' ELSE 'RUNNING' END, lease_until=CASE WHEN #{complete} THEN NULL ELSE lease_until END, completed_at=CASE WHEN #{complete} THEN clock_timestamp() ELSE completed_at END, error_code=NULL,error_id=NULL,updated_at=clock_timestamp() WHERE singleton=true AND state='RUNNING' AND lease_until>clock_timestamp()

UPDATE ad_event_sync_checkpoint SET state=CASE WHEN #{permanent} OR attempts>=3 THEN 'PAUSED' ELSE 'READY' END, error_code=#{reason},error_id=#{eventId,jdbcType=BIGINT},lease_until=NULL, available_at=clock_timestamp()+power(2,greatest(attempts-1,0))*interval '1 second',updated_at=clock_timestamp() WHERE worker=#{worker} AND fence=#{fence} AND state='RUNNING' AND lease_until>clock_timestamp()
UPDATE ad_event_sync_checkpoint SET state='READY',lease_until=NULL,updated_at=clock_timestamp() WHERE worker=#{worker} AND fence=#{fence} AND state='RUNNING' AND lease_until>clock_timestamp()

UPDATE ad_event_sync_checkpoint SET state='READY',epoch=epoch+1,upper_id=NULL,cursor_id=0,attempts=0,scanned=0,copied=0, fence=fence+1,lease_until=NULL,available_at=clock_timestamp(),error_code=NULL,error_id=NULL,completed_at=NULL,updated_at=clock_timestamp() WHERE lease_until IS NULL OR lease_until<=clock_timestamp()
mapper.select: SELECT command_id,action,actor,reason,epoch FROM ad_event_sync_audit WHERE command_id=#{id}

SELECT min(v.id) FROM (VALUES (CAST(#{row.id} AS bigint),CAST(#{row.requestId} AS text),CAST(#{row.query} AS text),CAST(#{row.userId} AS bigint),CAST(#{row.adId} AS bigint),CAST(#{row.bidwordId} AS bigint),CAST(#{row.position} AS integer),CAST(#{row.eventType} AS text),CAST(#{row.pctr} AS double precision),CAST(#{row.pctrCalib} AS double precision),CAST(#{row.ecpm} AS double precision),CAST(#{row.chargedPrice} AS double precision),CAST(#{row.relevance} AS double precision),CAST(#{row.adBucket} AS text),CAST(#{row.timestamp} AS timestamp),CAST(#{row.creativeId} AS bigint)) ) AS v(id,request_id,query,user_id,ad_id,bidword_id,position,event_type,pctr,pctr_calib,ecpm,charged_price,relevance,ad_bucket,ts,creative_id) JOIN ad_event_log t ON t.id=v.id WHERE ROW(t.id,t.request_id,t.query,t.user_id,t.ad_id,t.bidword_id,t.position,t.event_type,t.pctr,t.pctr_calib,t.ecpm,t.charged_price,t.relevance,t.ad_bucket,t.ts,t.creative_id) IS DISTINCT FROM ROW(v.id,v.request_id,v.query,v.user_id,v.ad_id,v.bidword_id,v.position,v.event_type,v.pctr,v.pctr_calib,v.ecpm,v.charged_price,v.relevance,v.ad_bucket,v.ts,v.creative_id)
